emu-compat-slot.name: EmuCompat
emu-compat-slot.description: Looks up PlayStation 2, 3 and 4 title IDs and shows the game name, emulator compatibility (PCSX2, RPCS3, ShadPS4), the latest PS3 patch version and SteamGridDB cover art.

showCover.label: Show cover art
showCover.description: Show the game's cover art from SteamGridDB. Requires an API key.

steamGridDbApiKey.label: SteamGridDB API key
steamGridDbApiKey.description: Required for cover art. Cover art stays disabled while this is empty.

showDescription.label: Show Wikipedia description
showDescription.description: Show the short Wikipedia summary for the title.

showDetails.label: Show details
showDetails.description: List the detail rows (compatibility, version) below the title.

showCompatibility.label: Show RPCS3 / ShadPS4 compatibility
showCompatibility.description: Look up PS3 titles in the RPCS3 database and PS4 titles in the ShadPS4 database.

showCompat.label: Show PCSX2 compatibility
showCompat.description: Show the PCSX2 compatibility rating for PS2 titles.

showVersion.label: Show version
showVersion.description: Show the latest PS3 update version. Sony's update server is only contacted while this is on.

showRegion.label: Show region badge
showRegion.description: Show the release region (US, EU, JP, ...) next to the title ID.

nameSearch.heading: Matching title IDs
nameSearch.hint: Use a title ID with the same command to see its details.
nameSearch.usage: Type a game name or a title ID after the command, for example
nameSearch.narrow: Add ps2, ps3 or ps4 to search a single platform, for example

emu-compat-command.name: PlayStation Emulation Lookup
emu-compat-command.description: Search PS2, PS3 and PS4 games by name or title ID. Add ps2, ps3 or ps4 to narrow it down.
